connectors.label: Acme CLI
connectors.description: The same fictional acme CLI, connected by declarative commands instead of a program.

descriptions.en: The same fictional acme CLI, connected by declarative commands instead of a program.
descriptions.zh-CN: 同一个虚构的 acme 命令行，用声明式命令接入，不写程序。

methods.label: Sign in with a session token

labels.en: Sign in with a session token

methods.description: Paste a token created with `acme tokens create`. Foundry writes it to the login command's stdin.

descriptions.en: Paste a token created with `acme tokens create`. Foundry writes it to the login command's stdin.
descriptions.zh-CN: 粘贴用 `acme tokens create` 创建的令牌。Foundry 会把它写到登录命令的 stdin。

fields.label: Session token
fields.help: Create one with `acme tokens create`. It is passed on stdin and not kept as a plain value.

helps.zh-CN: 用 `acme tokens create` 创建一个。它经 stdin 传给命令，不会以明文保存。
